subject: Observability add-ons: consolidation, crediting schedule, and SLA patch
messages:
From: Sarah Lopez <sarah@bluehorizon.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-30T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Observability add-ons — consolidated ask and billing flexibility

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We discussed observability add-ons (retention, tracing, advanced dashboards) and I promised to follow up with our ask. Blue Horizon is seeing a big ingestion spike as we onboard two new customers in Q2 — the baseline telemetry in the attached usage_report_Apr2027.csv gives the shape.

Top asks:
- Can you send a single consolidated commercial proposal that shows retention tiers (30/90/365 days), tracing span sampling options, and per-dashboard seat pricing?
- We need a crediting schedule to smooth the onboarding spike (prefer credits applied across the first 90 days).
- Target commercial aim: ~20% blended discount over 12 months, but we can be flexible if credits are front-loaded.
- Also need a quick note on SLA remedies (availability credits) and runbook for restore/retention rehydration windows.

Cc'ing Aaron (procurement) and our DevOps lead for transparency. Can you get a draft by EOW?

Appreciate it —
Sarah
Sarah Lopez
Head of Platform Ops, Blue Horizon AI

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lopez <sarah@bluehorizon.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-30T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — consolidated ask and billing flexibility

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the context and the usage CSV — that was super helpful. I've sketched three distinct packaging options and an initial crediting flow. See the attached redwood_addon_price_matrix.xlsx for the line items; summary below.

Quick summary (high level):
1) Metered retention path (pay per GB-month): best flexibility, lower upfront commitment.
   - 30d/90d/365d buckets at $0.025 / $0.018 / $0.012 per GB-month respectively.
   - Tracing: span-sampling tiers (1%, 5%, 20%) with a tracer storage uplift.
   - Dashboards: per-seat consumption $58 / seat / month (bulk discounts possible).
   - Onboarding credits: one-time credit pool — proposed $15k spread evenly across months 1-3.

2) Tiered slab commit (committed throughput/ingest): better unit economics for commitments.
   - Effective blended discount 15% at 12-month commit, 22% at 24-month commit.
   - 90d retention included in slab; extended retention add-on priced separately.
   - Onboarding credits: $25k applied month 1-2 (front-loaded).

3) Seat-first dashboards + add-on retention (enterprise simple): per-seat dashboard pricing with retention add-ons metered separately; good for predictable seat growth.

SLA / Credits: we typically offer a tiered monthly SLA credit: 5% credit for <99.9%, 10% for <99.5% — we can surface a clearer credit table in the SOW. We can include an explicit clause for retention rehydration windows (48–72 hours standard, expedited options available).

Notes / asks for you:
- If you want the 20% blended discount target, the fast path is a 24-month slab commit + deeper onboard credits.
- Confirm whether you prefer credits spread (months 1–3) or front-loaded.

I can send a formal commercial terms email + SOW attachment by Monday, May 3.

Best,
Chloe
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_addon_price_matrix.xlsx (XLSX stub)

From: Sarah Lopez <sarah@bluehorizon.ai>

Date: 2027-05-01T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — consolidated ask and billing flexibility

Chloe —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clear options. A couple of clarifications from our end:
- Can you shift the onboarding credits so they offset months 2–3 instead of month 1? Our finance team prefers less crediting in month 1 for procurement reasons.
- Can you provide explicit examples of how the SLA credit would be calculated against our expected ingest curve? We experienced a brief retention restore last year and need confidence in the restore window guarantees (48–72h is ok, can you add expedited restore pricing?).
- For dashboards: we like the seat-first model but need a playbook for migrating saved assets and role-based access (RBAC). Is migration assistance included with onboarding credits or a separate professional services line?

If you can include these items in the formal SOW and a sample DocuSign link (we'll route internally), we should be able to take a decision quickly.

Thanks —
Sarah

Date: 2027-05-02T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Observability add-ons — internal negotiating posture

Team — quick internal note before we send the formal revised terms to Blue Horizon. Summary of recommended posture:

1) Preserve list price on retention and tracing so we have margin to offer concessions; use credits to hit their blended discount target.
2) Offer a one-time onboarding credit of $25k for 12-month deals, $45k for 24-month deals. Make 50% of the credit front-loaded for 24-month (month 1), rest months 2-3 — this balances their ask and our billing cadence.
3) Seat pricing: propose $50 / seat / month as sticker; allow $45 / seat / month as a negotiated concession for a 24-month commit or >100 seats.
4) SLA: standard credit bands are fine; ensure legal signs off on expedited restore SLA (add a $10k expedited-restore retainer if they want sub-24hr).

Karthik — please draft the commercial amendment language (SOW section) that captures credit flow and SLA credit calculation. Michael — validate PS uplift and migration hours if we include migration assistance in onboarding credits vs billed separately.

Thanks —
Lauren

(note: internal only)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lopez <sarah@bluehorizon.ai>, Aaron Chen <aaron@procuresmart.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T14:26:00-07:00
Subject: Revised commercial terms + SOW (three options)

Hi Sarah / Aaron —

Per our thread and internal alignment, attached is a concise SOW + pricing sheet (BH_SOW_v3.pdf and redwood_addon_price_matrix.xlsx). Below are the three options with explicit crediting schedules and SLA notes.

Option A (Flex / Metered) — no commit
- Retention tiers: 30d $0.025/GB-mo, 90d $0.018/GB-mo, 365d $0.012/GB-mo.
- Dashboards: $58 / seat / month.
- Tracing: default 5% sampling included; higher retention priced per TB.
- Credits: $15k onboarding credit applied months 2–3 ($7.5k each).
- SLA: standard credit bands; restore window 48–72h; expedited restore available at $10k retainer.

Option B (12–24 month slab commit) — recommended for their 20% target
- Effective blended discount: 15% (12mo) / 22% (24mo).
- Included 90d retention in slab; extended retention add-on priced at $0.010/GB-mo for 365d.
- Dashboards: $50 / seat / month (sticker); $45 / seat / month if 24mo commit or >100 seats.
- Credits: $25k onboarding credit for 12mo, $45k for 24mo. For 24mo we propose 50% of credit front-loaded in month 1, remainder month 2–3.
- SLA: for availability below 99.9% we credit 5% of that month’s observability spend; below 99.5% credit 10%. Expedited restore (sub-24h) available with $10k retainer plus per-hour PS fees.

Option C (Seat-first + add-ons) — predictable seat billing
- Dashboards: $55 / seat / month, retention metered separately with volume tiers.
- Migration assistance can be included as PS hours bundled against onboarding credits (we propose 40 hours included for free for 24mo deals).

Next steps / asks from Blue Horizon:
1) Please confirm preferred option and whether you want credits front-loaded (we can change B to have 75% front-loaded if you need it).
2) Confirm whether expedited restore coverage is required (so we can reflect the retainer in SOW).
3) If acceptable, we'll prepare DocuSign-ready SOW with the agreed numbers and a payment schedule.

I've also included a sample SLA credit calculation worked example in the attachment. If you want, I can run a quick model against your attached usage CSV and send a monthly projection showing the net cashflow after credits.

Thanks —
Chloe
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: BH_SOW_v3.pdf (PDF stub), redwood_addon_price_matrix.xlsx (XLSX stub)

Chloe —

Thanks for the clear options and for folding in our crediting preference. We're leaning toward Option B (24-month commit) — we hit the 22% blended discount target in that scenario and like the included migration hours. A couple of asks before we sign:
- Can you reduce the seat concession to $45 / seat / month (we should be at ~80 seats at start).
- Can you front-load 50% of the $45k onboarding credit to month 1 (we need the cashflow to offset the spike).
- We'd like the expedited restore retainer deferred to a separate PO if possible (we'll consider it after the pilot).

If you can update the SOW with those two tweaks (seat price $45, credit front-load 50% month 1) we'll aim to return a countersigned DocuSign by May 10. Aaron will coordinate internal signoffs.

Appreciate the responsiveness —
Sarah
Sarah Lopez
Head of Platform Ops, Blue Horizon AI
